Trigger.Name: WHEN_VALIDATE_ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vCount number:=0;
BEGIN
 
IF :ctrl_blk_1.report_id is null then 
 show_error('5900');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
ELSE
 
 select nvl(count(*),0)
 into vCount
 from rpt_parm 
 where parm_id = :ctrl_blk_1.report_id;

 show_error('5900');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 null;
 end if;
END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE

BEGIN

 ------------Disable fields---------------------------
 
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.report_id');
 item_change('CTRL_BLK_1.rep_run','D');
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.disp_rep_status := 'Processing..Please wait ';
 synchronize ;
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CURSOR_STYLE,'BUSY');
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.od_value := nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.od_value,'N') ;
 
 
 -- create extract_id record in cnf_rpt_parm_select
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO cnf_rpt_parm_select 
 (APPL_ID, USER_NAME, REPORT_NAME, PARM_ID, PARM_NO, PARM_SELECT, PARM_CODE )
 VALUES
 ('DON',
 :banner.user_id,
 'CFRSERIS',
 :ctrl_blk_1.report_id,
 1,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.EXTRACT_ID,
 'EXTID' ) ; 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc-->1 :'||SQLERRM);
 PAUSE; 
 END;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id = 'ALL' THEN 
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO cnf_rpt_parm_select 
 (APPL_ID, USER_NAME, REPORT_NAME, PARM_ID, PARM_NO, PARM_SELECT, PARM_CODE )
 VALUES
 ('DON',
 :banner.user_id,
 'CFRSERIS',
 :ctrl_blk_1.report_id,
 2,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.contract_id,
 'CON' ) ; 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc-->2 :'||SQLERRM);
 PAUSE; 
 END;
 END IF;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.test_series_id = 'ALL' THEN 
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO cnf_rpt_parm_select 
 (APPL_ID, USER_NAME, REPORT_NAME, PARM_ID, PARM_NO, PARM_SELECT, PARM_CODE )
 VALUES
 ('DON',
 :banner.user_id,
 'CFRSERIS',
 :ctrl_blk_1.report_id,
 3,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.test_series_id,
 'TSID' ) ; 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc-->3 :'||SQLERRM);
 PAUSE; 
 END;
 END IF;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id = 'ALL' THEN 
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO cnf_rpt_parm_select 
 (APPL_ID, USER_NAME, REPORT_NAME, PARM_ID, PARM_NO, PARM_SELECT, PARM_CODE )
 VALUES
 ('DON',
 :banner.user_id,
 'CFRSERIS',
 :ctrl_blk_1.report_id,
 4,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.unit_id,
 'UNIT' ) ; 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc-->4 :'||SQLERRM);
 PAUSE; 
 END;
 END IF;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.test_id = 'ALL' THEN 
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO cnf_rpt_parm_select 
 (APPL_ID, USER_NAME, REPORT_NAME, PARM_ID, PARM_NO, PARM_SELECT, PARM_CODE )
 VALUES
 ('DON',
 :banner.user_id,
 'CFRSERIS',
 :ctrl_blk_1.report_id,
 5,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.test_id,
 'TSTID' ) ; 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc-->5 :'||SQLERRM);
 PAUSE; 
 END;
 END IF;

 -- create od_value record in cnf_rpt_parm_select
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO cnf_rpt_parm_select 
 (APPL_ID, USER_NAME, REPORT_NAME, PARM_ID, PARM_NO, PARM_SELECT, PARM_CODE )
 VALUES
 ('DON',
 :banner.user_id,
 'CFRSERIS',
 :ctrl_blk_1.report_id,
 6,
 :CTRL_BLK_1.od_value,
 'ODVAL' ) ; 
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 MESSAGE('Loc-->6 :'||SQLERRM);
 PAUSE; 
 END;

 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=10;
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:=0;
 
 -- call package to create individual entries in the RPT_PARM and RPT_PARM_SELECT tables 
 -- for each unit_id based on the params entered by the USER
 
 generate_series_report.pop_rpt_parm_tables(:ctrl_blk_1.report_id, -- RPT_PARM.PARM_ID
 :banner.user_id, -- USER
 :global.chapter_id, -- CHAPTER_ID
 'F', -- run from FORM
 null) ; -- scheduled time not used in form
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.disp_rep_status := 'Submitted .... ';
 synchronize ;
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CURSOR_STYLE,'DEFAULT');
 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE THEN
 RAISE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM'); -- to re-try logon
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 nCount NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
 if :cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select is not null then

 IF :GLOBAL.parm_code = 'CON' THEN
 IF NVL(:cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select, '*') != 'ALL' then 

 select NVL(COUNT(1), 0)
 INTO nCount
 from contracts 
 where LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id, :global.chapter_id) = 'Y'
 and (upper(company) like upper('%'||:ctrl_blk_1.contract_id||'%') or
 (contract_id like :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id ||'%'))
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,sysdate) = 'Y'
 and contract_id = :cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select ;
 
 IF nCount = 0 THEN
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 END IF ;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.parm_code = 'TSID' THEN
 
 IF NVL(:cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select, '*') != 'ALL' then 
 
 select NVL(COUNT(1), 0)
 INTO nCount
 FROM valid_series_test_config vstc, 
 master_codes mc
 where vstc.test_series_id = mc.code
 and mc.code_type = 'TRGID'
 and :banner.hdr_date between mc.eff_date and nvl(mc.term_date, sysdate+ 30)
 and :banner.hdr_date between vstc.eff_date and nvl(vstc.term_date, sysdate + 30) 
 and vstc.test_series_id = :cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select ;
 
 IF nCount = 0 THEN
 show_error('1408');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 END IF ;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.parm_code = 'UNIT' THEN
 
 IF NVL(:cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select, '*') != 'ALL' then
 SELECT NVL(COUNT(1), 0)
 INTO nCount
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = :cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select;
 
 IF nCount = 0 THEN
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 END IF ; 
 
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.parm_code = 'TSTID' THEN

 IF NVL(:cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select, '*') != 'ALL' then 

 SELECT NVL(COUNT(1), 0)
 INTO nCount
 FROM valid_tests
 WHERE test_id = :cnf_rpt_parm_select.parm_select
 AND :banner.hdr_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 10);
 
 IF nCount = 0 THEN
 show_error('1277');
 check_package_failure;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ITEM_CHANGE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE item_change (p_item_name in varchar2,p_mode in varchar2) IS
 it_id item ;
BEGIN
 it_id := find_item(p_item_name) ;
 IF Id_Null(it_id) THEN 
 Message('No such item: '||p_item_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 if p_mode = 'E' then
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 set_item_property(it_id,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 
 if get_item_property(it_id,ITEM_TYPE) != 'BUTTON' then
 set_item_property(it_id,UPDATEABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE) ;
 end if ;
 
 elsif p_mode = 'D' then
 set_item_property(it_id,ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 show_error('1706');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('0') -- invalid format
 then
 show_error('0022',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK)); 
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
